I fixed `median()` in `app/stats.py`, but I couldn't run the tests, so the fix is unverified.

`python -m pytest -q` failed because pytest isn't installed in this Python environment. My attempt to install it was denied, so I stopped there.

**The fix:** `median()` now raises `ValueError` on an empty list. For an odd count it returns the middle element. For an even count it returns the mean of the two middle values, after sorting, so input order doesn't matter.

**Tests:** I added three cases to `tests/test_stats.py`: an even-length list (`[4, 1, 3, 2]` gives `2.5`), a two-element unsorted list (`[10, 2]` gives `6`), and an empty list raising `ValueError`. The existing odd-length test is unchanged.

Once pytest is installed (`python -m pip install pytest`), `python -m pytest -q` will run them. I can install it if you give permission.
